item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Union WCD Minister, Smt. Annpurna Devi hails the stellar performance of India’s women athletes at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026
Posted On: 03 AUG 2026 12:36PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister of Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi has hailed the stellar performance of India’s women athletes at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026, where Nari Shakti powered Team India’s golden campaign by winning 8 of India’s 13 Gold medals across Boxing, Weightlifting, Judo and Para Athletics.

In a post on ‘X’ the Union Minister said that five Indian women boxers clinched Gold, showcasing India’s growing dominance and depth in the sport. She stated that their courage, resilience and excellence reflect the remarkable rise of women in Indian sports and are inspiring a new generation of girls to dream big, pursue excellence and proudly represent India on the global stage.

She added that under the visionary leadership of Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, India’s daughters continue to script a new era of sporting excellence.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Coal
Monthly Production and Dispatch from Captive and Commercial Mines Continue Upward Growth in July 2026
Posted On: 03 AUG 2026 12:21PM by PIB Delhi

Maintaining its strong growth trajectory, the Captive and Commercial coal mining sector continued to deliver higher production in July 2026, reinforcing its growing role in India's coal ecosystem. During the month, coal production from Captive and Commercial mines stood at 14.78 million tonnes (MT), while coal dispatches reached 17.49 MT. Coal production registered a 9.61% year-on-year growth compared to July 2025, reflecting sustained momentum in mining operations and the increasing contribution of these mines to the country's domestic coal output.

The encouraging performance highlights continued improvements in operational efficiency, enhanced mining productivity, and more effective utilisation of mining capacities across the Captive and Commercial coal mining sector.

The accompanying graph illustrates the production and dispatch performance during the month (in million tonnes).

 

 

The sustained rise in production from Captive and Commercial mines is expected to reduce dependence on imported coal, strengthen supply chain resilience, conserve valuable foreign exchange, and advance the Government's vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat by enhancing self-reliance in a critical raw material essential for the nation's energy security and industrial development.

The Ministry of Coal remains committed to fully unlocking the potential of the Captive and Commercial coal mining sector. It will continue to sustain production growth, address supply-side constraints, and improve coal availability through progressive policy interventions, robust regulatory oversight, and continued stakeholder support, while ensuring that the sector makes a reliable contribution towards meeting the nation's growing energy and industrial requirements.

****

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Rural Development
From Skills to National Honour: Six DDU-GKY Youth Invited as Special Guests for India’s 80th Independence Day Celebrations
Posted On: 03 AUG 2026 11:32AM by PIB Delhi

In a significant recognition of the transformative impact of rural skill development, six beneficiaries of the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY), representing West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Mizoram and Nagaland, have been invited as Special Guests for India’s 80th Independence Day celebrations in New Delhi on 15 August 2026.

The selected beneficiaries have received their official invitation letters through India Post to attend the Independence Day ceremony at the Red Fort and the prestigious ‘At Home’ dinner reception hosted by the Hon’ble President of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan. This honour is not only a recognition of their individual achievements, but also a national acknowledgement of the transformation enabled by DDU-GKY through skills, sustainable livelihoods and dignified employment.

 

The youth will witness the national ceremony at the Red Fort and participate in the reception at Rashtrapati Bhavan. Their presence at these prestigious national events is a proud moment for the rural skilling ecosystem and for the young achievers who have emerged through DDU-GKY.

DDU-GKY is the flagship placement-linked skill development programme under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) of the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. The programme equips rural poor youth with industry-relevant skills, nationally recognised certifications, and access to sustainable and dignified employment opportunities.

Through DDU-GKY, lakhs of rural youth across the country have been connected with long-term livelihood opportunities. The programme has enabled them to become economically empowered, self-reliant and active contributors to India’s growth story.

The invitation extended to these six beneficiaries is a national recognition of the scheme’s success in creating a skilled workforce and promoting sustainable livelihoods. It demonstrates that skill development goes beyond employment—it enables dignified careers, economic independence and a more secure future for rural youth.

This achievement reflects the determination and hard work of the selected beneficiaries, as well as the collective efforts of the respective State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs), Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs), and the Ministry of Rural Development.

The honour will inspire millions of rural youth across India and reinforce the vision that skills create opportunities, sustainable livelihoods build self-reliance, and empowered youth accelerate the journey towards a Viksit Bharat.

item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister's Office
Prime Minister expresses pride in Indian contingent’s performance at Commonwealth Games 2026
Posted On: 03 AUG 2026 9:55AM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has expressed pride in the performance of the Indian contingent at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow.

The Prime Minister expressed delight that India won 39 medals, including 13 Gold medals, and congratulated all the medal winners.

Shri Modi said that throughout the Games, the Indian athletes displayed exceptional skill, determination and dedication. He added that their hard work will continue to inspire the nation’s youth.

Shri Modi also extended his best wishes to the entire Indian contingent for their future endeavours and expressed hope that they would continue to bring greater glory to the nation.

Shri Modi wrote on X;

“Proud of our contingent’s performance at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games. 

Delighted that India has won 39 medals, including 13 Golds. Congrats to the medal winners. 

Throughout the Games, our talented athletes have displayed exceptional skill, determination and dedication. Their hardwork will keep inspiring our youngsters. 

My best wishes to the entire Indian contingent for the endeavours ahead. May they continue to give their very best and bring further glory to the nation.

#CWG2026”

 

Proud of our contingent’s performance at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games.

Delighted that India has won 39 medals, including 13 Golds. Congrats to the medal winners.

Throughout the Games, our talented athletes have displayed exceptional skill, determination and dedication.…

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 3, 2026

item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister's Office
Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of courage and perseverance
Posted On: 03 AUG 2026 9:51AM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, said that one should never lose courage even when fortune turns unfavourable, for patience and perseverance can help a person regain lost ground. He noted that just as a skilled sailor whose ship breaks apart in the middle of the ocean does not lose hope but continues striving to survive by swimming, determination and steadfast effort enable one to overcome adversity.

The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam-

“त्याज्यं न धैर्यं विधुरेऽपि दैवे धैर्यात्कदाचित्स्थितिमाप्नुयात्सः।

याते समुद्रेऽपि च पोतभङ्गे सांयात्रिको वाञ्छति कर्म एव।। ”

The Subhashitam conveys that one should not lose patience even when fortune is adverse, for through patience, one can always regain a lost favorable situation. Just as a skilled sailor, even when his ship breaks apart in the middle of the ocean, focuses solely on his actions, namely, the effort to survive and swim, without losing heart.

The Prime Minister wrote on X;

“त्याज्यं न धैर्यं विधुरेऽपि दैवे धैर्यात्कदाचित्स्थितिमाप्नुयात्सः।

याते समुद्रेऽपि च पोतभङ्गे सांयात्रिको वाञ्छति कर्म एव ।।”

 

त्याज्यं न धैर्यं विधुरेऽपि दैवे धैर्यात्कदाचित्स्थितिमाप्नुयात्सः।

याते समुद्रेऽपि च पोतभङ्गे सांयात्रिको वाञ्छति कर्म एव ।। pic.twitter.com/m5PshMgvV6

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 3, 2026

“काशी की पावन धरती से उठा कल्याणकारी विचार अब एक नेशनल प्रोजेक्ट बन गया है। मुझे पूरा विश्वास है कि 'नशा मुक्त युवा-विकसित भारत संकल्प अभियान' सामूहिकता की ताकत से हर युवा मन को छूने वाला है।”

 

काशी की पावन धरती से उठा कल्याणकारी विचार अब एक नेशनल प्रोजेक्ट बन गया है। मुझे पूरा विश्वास है कि 'नशा मुक्त युवा-विकसित भारत संकल्प अभियान' सामूहिकता की ताकत से हर युवा मन को छूने वाला है। pic.twitter.com/Z4CGfOPxHN

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 2, 2026

 

“ड्रग्स कुछ समय के लिए ‘High’ देता है, लेकिन करियर और फैमिली लाइफ को ‘Low’ कर देता है। इसलिए नशा मुक्त रहकर हमारे युवाओं को अपने Potential को Protect करना है!”

Shri Modi said that the Tiranga fills every Indian heart with immense pride and inspires the nation to work towards nation-building.

item.title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi Launches 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan'; Calls Upon Every Citizen to Join the Movement
item.category: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
item.dc:creator: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
item.description: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi Launches 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan'; Calls Upon Every Citizen to Join the Movement Over One Crore Youth Join Prime Minister's Call for a Drug-Free India as 100-Week 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan' Begins 'The Coming 100 Sundays Will Be 100 Strong Steps Towards a Drug-Free India': Prime Minister Nasha Mukta Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyaan Will Become a Nationwide Jan Bhagidari Under Prime Minister's Leadership: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya Posted On: 02…
item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi Launches 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan'; Calls Upon Every Citizen to Join the Movement
Over One Crore Youth Join Prime Minister's Call for a Drug-Free India as 100-Week 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan' Begins
'The Coming 100 Sundays Will Be 100 Strong Steps Towards a Drug-Free India': Prime Minister
Nasha Mukta Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyaan Will Become a Nationwide Jan Bhagidari Under Prime Minister's Leadership: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 7:13PM by PIB Delhi

Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today launched ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan’. Addressing a massive nationwide video conference, the Prime Minister formally greeted the diverse assembly including over one crore young citizens connected from more than 28,000 locations. Emphasizing the collective weight of the moment, he framed the gathering as a profound national commitment. "Today, all of us countrymen have united for a great and important resolution," remarked Shri Modi.

Highlighting the comprehensive nature of the initiative, the Prime Minister explained that the campaign transcends individual wellness, simultaneously serving the broader interests of families, society, and the entire nation. Outlining the core objective behind the 'Drug-Free Youth for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan', he stressed that achieving Viksit Bharat fundamentally requires a physically healthy, mentally robust, and highly confident younger generation completely free from self-destructive habits. ''Today, as the nation has set the goal of a Viksit Bharat,  it is imperative that the country's youth remain physically and mentally fit, brimming with self-confidence, and permanently steer clear of destructive habits like drugs," asserted Shri Modi.

Reflecting on the campaign's origins, the Prime Minister expressed deep satisfaction that the initiative initially launched as a pilot project from the sacred land of Kashi the previous year. Highlighting the unique blend of scientific clarity, spiritual energy, and profound cultural dedication driving the movement, he noted its massive expansion. "Supported by over 125 spiritual organizations and numerous NGOs under the Kashi Declaration, that welfare-driven idea has now successfully become a National project," observed Shri Modi.

Welcoming the Prime Minister, Union Minister of Youth Affairs & Sports and Labour & Employment, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, said that the launch of the "Nasha Mukta Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyaan" marks another significant milestone in the journey towards realizing the Prime Minister's vision of Viksit Bharat @2047. He noted that the Prime Minister has consistently placed India's youth at the centre of nation-building, envisioning them as the driving force of Amrit Kaal. Guided by this vision, the Government established MY Bharat as a single-window platform to provide young people with opportunities for volunteering, leadership, mentorship and national service, connecting over 2.23 crore youth across the country. Recalling the Prime Minister's call from the Red Fort for a drug-free India, Dr. Mandaviya said MY Bharat has been actively advancing this mission through sustained youth engagement. He further highlighted that the 100-Week Action Plan and the Kashi Declaration, evolved through consultations with leading spiritual organisations, have laid the foundation for a nationwide people's movement against substance abuse. Expressing confidence in the campaign, he said that just as people's participation under the Prime Minister's leadership transformed initiatives such as Swachh Bharat, Fit India and several other national movements into mass successes, the "Nasha Mukta Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyaan" would similarly inspire millions of young Indians to contribute towards building a healthy, drug-free and developed India. Union Minister of State of Youth Affairs and Sports, Smt. Raksha Nikhil Khadse, 26 Governors of States and Chief Ministers of 11 states also joined the nationwide movement.

Commending the millions of youth who took the anti-drug oath, the Prime Minister praised their solemn commitment to maintaining personal sobriety while actively disseminating the message of a drug-free life across their schools, colleges, and communities. Outlining the campaign's ambitious 100-week roadmap, he detailed how every upcoming Sunday will feature dedicated activities spanning art, culture, sports, and meditation to continually engage new participants. "The coming 100 Sundays will absolutely become 100 strong steps in the direction of a completely drug-free India," affirmed Shri Modi.

Addressing the vast online gathering of students, NSS members, and My Bharat volunteers, the Prime Minister expressed immense pride in the profound awareness, sensibility, and serious dedication demonstrated by the nation's youth. Positioning the younger demographic as India's 'Amrit generation', he reminded them that their energy, imagination, and talent are vital for guiding the nation toward its 2047 developmental goals. "For the ultimate future of the country and for your own lives, it is absolutely essential to keep yourselves free from addiction," asserted Shri Modi.

Contrasting the stellar achievements of today's youth in startups, artificial intelligence, sports, and space exploration with the devastating impacts of substance abuse, the Prime Minister delivered a stark warning about how addiction derails focus and destroys dreams. Illustrating the profound collateral damage inflicted upon families, from shattering parents' dreams to causing daily agony for elders, he emphasized the broader societal toll. "When this devastation happens in a family or society, the overall strength of the entire nation also fundamentally weakens," noted Shri Modi

Warning the youth against the deceptive nature of narcotics, the Prime Minister stressed that the temporary high provided by drugs ultimately results in a permanent low for their careers and family lives. Drawing upon the profound wisdom of Indian culture and spiritual leaders, including specific teachings from the Sri Guru Granth Sahib, he highlighted the historical societal rejection of mind-altering substances. "We must absolutely not give any kind of social acceptance to intoxication under any circumstances," asserted Shri Modi.

Detailing the comprehensive support systems available for recovery, the Prime Minister highlighted the effectiveness of societal cooperation, yoga, meditation, and modern rehabilitation centers in overcoming addiction. Urging families to prioritize medical intervention over misguided concerns regarding social prestige, he advocated for a culture of open domestic communication to prevent vulnerable children from falling into the trap. "If a youth has mistakenly fallen into addiction, it absolutely does not mean that all their paths are permanently closed," affirmed Shri Modi.

Directing a specific appeal to academic professionals, the Prime Minister urged college and university professors to actively integrate discussions about the dangers of drugs into their regular curriculum and launch dedicated anti-intoxication movements on their campuses. Shifting focus to those recovering from addiction, he called for societal respect and second chances for these individuals, completely rejecting the stigma associated with their past. "The youth who come out fighting addiction are not weak; they are real warriors whose incredible courage is their true identity," remarked Shri Modi.

Concluding the address, the Prime Minister assured the youth that the government stands firmly alongside them in this crucial battle, citing unprecedented nationwide crackdowns, massive seizures worth thousands of crores, and soaring arrest rates targeting drug dealers and smugglers. Expressing unwavering faith in the younger generation's resilience, he predicted a highly successful outcome for the national initiative. "I am confident that our youth will protect their energy by staying free from addiction and will take the resolutions of Viksit Bharat forward," affirmed Shri Modi.

***

Pawan Singh Faujdar

(Release ID: 2293495)

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
No Manual Scavengers Identified in Fresh Survey Conducted Under MS Act, 2013: Government
89,915 Sewer and Septic Tank Workers Validated Under NAMASTE Scheme Across the Country
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 4:42PM by PIB Delhi

The Government of India has reaffirmed its commitment to eliminating manual scavenging and ensuring the safety, dignity and welfare of Sewer and Septic Tank Workers (SSWs) through legislative measures and targeted welfare initiatives. The Government informed the Rajya Sabha that a fresh survey conducted across all districts of the country under the provisions of the Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation Act, 2013 (MS Act, 2013) found no manual scavengers.

Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment Shri Ramdas Athawale Shares Details in Written Reply to Shri Derek O' Brien in Rajya Sabha. The House was informed that the National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) Scheme, launched during 2023-24, aims to ensure the safety and dignity of Sewer and Septic Tank Workers through mechanisation and comprehensive welfare measures. Under the scheme, 89,915 Sewer and Septic Tank Workers have been validated across the country. State-wise details of the validated workers have been placed on the Table of the House.

The written reply further stated that the Government is implementing several interventions under the NAMASTE Scheme to improve occupational safety and promote mechanised sanitation. These include distribution of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) kits, occupational safety training, provision of safety devices to Emergency Response Sanitation Units (ERSUs), upfront capital subsidy for sanitation-related machinery to sanitation workers, their groups and Private Sanitation Service Operators (PSSOs), health insurance coverage, and workshops on prevention of hazardous cleaning of sewers and septic tanks.

The House was also informed that Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban (SBM-U) 2.0, launched on 1 October 2021, includes Used Water Management (UWM) as one of its key components, with the objective of eradicating hazardous entry into sewers and septic tanks by promoting mechanised sewer and septic tank cleaning operations.

Replying to the query regarding the continued existence of manual scavenging, the Government reiterated that the MS Act, 2013 prohibits the construction and maintenance of insanitary latrines and bans the employment or engagement of any person for hazardous manual cleaning of sewers and septic tanks. The Government has also requested all States and Union Territories to ensure effective implementation of the provisions of the Act.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Transforming Waste into Wealth: How VCF-SC Enabled a Scheduled Caste Woman Entrepreneur to Build a Sustainable Rubber Recycling Enterprise
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 4:40PM by PIB Delhi

Mrs. Swarnalatha Nethipudi

Innovation, entrepreneurship and timely institutional support have empowered many aspiring entrepreneurs to establish businesses that contribute to India's economic growth and environmental sustainability. One such inspiring example is Swarnakaruna Princeton Rubber Industries Private Limited, a company based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, founded by Mrs. Swarnalatha Nethipudi, a first-generation Scheduled Caste woman entrepreneur. Her entrepreneurial journey reflects the transformative impact of the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

Swarnakaruna Princeton Rubber Industries Private Limited has established an automated rubber recycling plant for converting waste tyres into high-quality crumb rubber powder ranging from 10 mesh to 40 mesh, with an installed production capacity of approximately 6,000 metric tonnes per annum. The environmentally sustainable project addresses the challenge of waste tyre disposal while promoting a circular economy through the production of value-added industrial raw materials. Recognising the project's potential, the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes extended financial assistance of ₹5 crore in 2023 through venture capital assistance comprising equity and optionally convertible debentures. The support also enabled the enterprise to secure a second round of funding from SIDBI, further strengthening its growth trajectory.

Facility

Automated Rubber Recycling Facility

The financial assistance enabled the company to establish advanced crumb rubber manufacturing infrastructure, recycle more than two lakh waste tyres, generate employment opportunities for local communities and promote environmentally sustainable waste management practices. The enterprise has also developed strong industrial linkages with reputed companies, including TVS Sundaram and Hincol, enhancing its market reach and long-term sustainability.

The impact of the intervention has been significant. Today, the enterprise has generated direct employment for 15 people, including 5 Scheduled Caste employees and 10 non-Scheduled Caste employees. It has created assets worth approximately ₹8 crore, achieved a net worth of ₹2.09 crore, generated revenue of ₹4.36 crore, and recorded profits of ₹4.60 crore. The project has emerged as a model of environmentally responsible industrial development by converting waste into valuable industrial products while creating livelihoods and promoting sustainable manufacturing practices.

Mrs. Swarnalatha Nethipudi, Promoter

Reflecting on the journey, Mrs. Swarnalatha Nethipudi said:

"With the support of Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, our enterprise gained the financial backing which enabled us to transform an environmental challenge into a sustainable business opportunity. Today, Swarnakaruna Princeton Rubber Industries is converting waste tyres into valuable industrial products, creating employment, promoting circular economy practices, and contributing towards a cleaner and greener India."

Automated Rubber Recycling Facility

The success of Swarnakaruna Princeton Rubber Industries Private Limited demonstrates how targeted financial support under the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes is enabling Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs to establish innovative enterprises in emerging sectors, generate sustainable employment and contribute to India's vision of environmentally responsible industrial development. By fostering entrepreneurship and promoting inclusive economic growth, the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment continues to empower innovators, create livelihoods and build a greener and more sustainable future for the nation.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Empowering SC-led Innovation: How VCF-SC Enabled Thrishanku Technologies to Strengthen India's Defence Electronics Ecosystem
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 4:38PM by PIB Delhi

Innovation, entrepreneurship and timely institutional support have enabled many aspiring entrepreneurs to establish enterprises that contribute to India's technological advancement and self-reliance. One such inspiring example is Thrishanku Technologies Private Limited, a Bengaluru-based company founded by Mr. Suneel Kumar Sirigiri. The company's journey demonstrates the transformative impact of the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

Thrishanku Technologies Private Limited has established a state-of-the-art electronics design and manufacturing facility dedicated to the production of printed circuit boards (PCBs), radar systems and EDGE AI devices. The company provides advanced electronic manufacturing services to reputed organisations, including L&T, BEL, DRDO laboratories, ECIL, Astra Microwave Products Ltd., Capgemini, Wipro and Cypress. Recognising the project's strategic importance, the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes extended financial assistance of ₹4.47 crore in 2022 through venture capital assistance comprising equity and optionally convertible debentures.

Suneel Kumar Sirigiri

Electronics Design, Radar Systems & EDGE AI Manufacturing Facility

The financial assistance enabled the company to establish a world-class electronics manufacturing facility at the KIADB Hi-Tech Defence & Aerospace Park. The support facilitated the procurement of advanced machinery, testing instruments and software tools, strengthened the company's capabilities in radar systems and EDGE AI product development, and generated skilled employment opportunities in the technology sector.

The impact of the intervention has been significant. Today, the enterprise has generated direct employment for 30 professionals, including 8 Scheduled Caste employees and 22 non-Scheduled Caste employees. It has created assets worth ₹7 crore, achieved a net worth of ₹3.92 crore, generated revenue of ₹2.85 crore, and recorded a profit of approximately ₹4 lakh. The company has also established strong business linkages with India's defence, aerospace and industrial sectors, contributing to the vision of Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat.

Electronics Design, Radar Systems &

Mr. Suneel Kumar Sirigiri, Director

Reflecting on the journey, Mr. Suneel Kumar Sirigiri said:

"The concessional finance received under the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC) enabled us to transform a technology-driven vision into a world-class electronics manufacturing enterprise. Today, Thrishanku Technologies is contributing to India's defence and aerospace ecosystem under the 'Make in India' initiative while creating skilled employment opportunities and demonstrating the potential of SC-led innovation in advanced technology sectors."

Electronics Design, Radar Systems & EDGE AI Manufacturing Facility

The success of Thrishanku Technologies Private Limited demonstrates how targeted financial support under the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes is empowering Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs to establish globally competitive enterprises in advanced technology sectors. By promoting innovation, strengthening indigenous manufacturing capabilities and generating quality employment, the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment continues to foster inclusive entrepreneurship and contribute towards building an Atmanirbhar Bharat driven by technology, innovation and social empowerment.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
47,328 Villages Selected Under PM-AJAY Adarsh Gram Component Across the Country; 435 Villages in Telangana
Over 3.28 Lakh Development Works Identified and More Than 47.59 Lakh Beneficiaries Covered Under the Scheme
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 4:35PM by PIB Delhi

The Government of India is implementing the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY) to promote the socio-economic development of Scheduled Caste communities through the integrated development of villages under its Adarsh Gram Component. The scheme aims to ensure saturation of key socio-economic indicators by converging Central and State Government schemes and addressing critical development gaps.

Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment Shri Ramdas Athawale Shares Details in written to Shri Anil Kumar Yadav Mandadi in Rajya Sabha. The House was informed that 47,328 villages have been selected across the country under the Adarsh Gram Component of PM-AJAY, including 435 villages in Telangana. State-wise details of the selected villages have been placed on the Table of the House.

The written reply further stated that the Adarsh Gram Component focuses on the integrated development of selected villages through the saturation of 50 monitorable socio-economic indicators across 10 sectors, including education. A need assessment survey is conducted to establish the baseline status of these indicators. Identified gaps are addressed through convergence with Central and State Government schemes or through interventions supported under PM-AJAY. Progress made by States is regularly updated on the PMAGY Portal.

The House was also informed that, across the country, 3,28,131 development works and 1,10,51,213 beneficiaries have been identified under the scheme. Of these, 46,642 development works have been completed, benefiting 47,59,399 beneficiaries so far.

With regard to Telangana, the written reply stated that under the education sector, 3,529 beneficiaries have been identified, out of which 472 beneficiaries have already received benefits under the scheme.

Replying to the query regarding third-party audit, the House was informed that States and Union Territories have been directed to verify the self-declaration of Adarsh Gram under the PM-AJAY Adarsh Gram Component.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Defence
4th Tri-Services Future Warfare Course set to begin in New Delhi
Four-week course to focus on evolving warfare, emerging technologies, geopolitical developments & multi-domain operations
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 4:11PM by PIB Delhi

The fourth edition of the Tri-Services Future Warfare Course will commence at Manekshaw Centre, New Delhi on August 03, 2026. The four-week course is being conducted under the aegis of the Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff (HQ IDS) and coordinated by the Centre for Joint Warfare Studies (CENJOWS).

The course brings together officers from the three Services, along with representatives from government organisations, academia, industry and strategic think-tanks. The curriculum covers a wide range of subjects, including geopolitical developments, artificial intelligence, quantum technologies, cyber and cognitive warfare, information warfare, autonomous systems, future operations in the land, maritime, air and space domains, grey-zone operations, multi-domain operations and technology-enabled warfare.

The participants will attend lectures by senior military officers, policymakers, scientists, industry leaders and subject matter experts. The course seeks to promote a joint understanding of emerging operational challenges and encourage informed discussions on issues that are expected to influence the future battlefield.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Science & Technology
Dr Jitendra Singh reviews status of Ujh Multipurpose Project in Jammu & Kashmir
Project to be implemented in phases while remaining land acquisition proceeds simultaneously
Ujh Multipurpose Project to provide irrigation to nearly 90,000 hectares of land in Kathua and Samba districts of J&K. and Pathankot and Gurdaspur districts of Punjab; also supply drinking water to Kathua district
Under PM Modi’s leadership, long-pending Ujh and Shahpurkandi projects revived to optimise India’s Ravi waters: Dr Jitendra Singh
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 4:01PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Science and Technology; Earth Sciences and Minister of State for PMO, Department of Atomic Energy, Department of Space, Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Dr. Jitendra Singh reviewed the status and phased implementation roadmap of the Ujh Multipurpose Project (MPP) in Kathua district of Jammu & Kashmir.

The Minister held a detailed meeting with the officials of WAPCOS Ltd., a Government of India undertaking under the Ministry of Jal Shakti, which has been entrusted with the implementation of the project.

Dr Jitendra Singh emphasised the need for expeditious implementation so that the benefits of this strategically important project reach the people at the earliest. He advised WAPCOS to explore innovative solutions and implementation strategies while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety and efficiency.

The Minister was informed that the project is being taken up in a phased manner. Work will commence while acquisition of the remaining land is pursued simultaneously, without waiting for completion of the entire land acquisition process. The implementing agency is also working out the project site and related requirements.

Under the leadership of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, Dr Jitendra Singh said, long-pending national projects are being taken forward with renewed urgency. He noted that the Ujh Multipurpose Project, conceived nearly a century ago, had remained in limbo for decades, while the Shahpurkandi project had remained pending for about four decades. The delay in implementation of these projects, he said, resulted in the waters of the Ravi River and its tributaries continuing to flow into Pakistan.

The Minister said that even when the Indus Waters Treaty was in force, Ravi, Satluj and Beas were India’s three rivers under the Treaty, with Ravi being the major river among them. He noted that the Treaty is now in abeyance.

Dr Jitendra Singh said that the revival of the Shahpurkandi project in 2019, which is now almost complete, and the revival of the Ujh Multipurpose Project in 2026 reflect the Government’s resolve under Prime Minister Narendra Modi to realise long-delayed projects, optimise the use of India’s water resources and deliver tangible benefits to the people.

The Ujh Multipurpose Project, located on the Ujh River, a main tributary of the Ravi River, is designed to generate around 186 MW to 212 MW of electricity. It is expected to provide irrigation to nearly 90,000 hectares of agricultural land in Kathua and Samba districts of Jammu & Kashmir and Pathankot and Gurdaspur districts of Punjab. The project will also supply drinking water to Kathua district and provide industrial water availability.

The project is expected to strengthen agricultural productivity, improve water security, create new opportunities for economic development and contribute to the overall socio-economic progress of the Union Territory. It also has an important security and border-management dimension and is backed by the Ministry of Home Affairs to restrict unregulated water flows and plug vulnerable cross-border infiltration routes along the riverbed.

Dr Jitendra Singh reviewed the implementation milestones in detail and stressed the need for close coordination among all stakeholders and effective monitoring for timely execution. He assured WAPCOS of the Government’s full support and cooperation for the successful implementation and timely completion of the prestigious project.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation
Meeting of Heads of National Statistical Offices of BRICS Countries
"Quality Statistics as Driver of Change"
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 3:58PM by PIB Delhi

The meeting of Heads of National Statistical Offices (NSO) of BRICS Countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates (UAE)) is scheduled to be held under the Chairship of India from 03 to 04 August 2026, at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

India's BRICS Chairship in 2026 is guided by the overarching theme "Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability (BRICS)." Within the BRICS Statistics track, India has adopted the theme "Quality Statistics as Driver of Change", reflecting an unwavering commitment to data quality, innovation, effective dissemination, and people-centric statistical systems that are responsive to rapid technological advancements, the growing demand for high-frequency and granular data, and the increasing reliance on official statistics to support evidence-based, sustainable, and inclusive development.

Modern BRICS policymaking relies on robust statistics to track development, guide decisions, and build mutual understanding. Since 2010, member countries have published the Joint Statistical Publication (JSP) and Snapshot BRICS JSP (introduced in 2020) to offer accessible, harmonized data. Over time, BRICS statistical cooperation has evolved from basic data collection into deeper alignment on data standards, harmonization, and innovation for policymakers, researchers, and the public. Two main events on statistical matters are held every year along with side events:

(i) Technical Meeting of NSOs

(ii) Meeting of Heads of NSOs

The Technical Meeting was held during 16 April-17 April, 2026 primarily to facilitate discussions on the chapters of the BRICS JSP and Snapshot BRICS JSP, The discussions were focussed on developing a mutually agreed framework for the JSP and Snapshot 2026, as well as determining the allocation of responsibilities and establishing timelines for contributions from each National Statistical Office (NSO).

The BRICS Statistics Track aims to deliver outcomes under the following priority areas:

  • Strengthening Core BRICS Statistical Products (JSP & Snapshot)
  • Innovation and Reform in National Statistical Systems
  • Data Dissemination and Accessibility
  • Strengthening Macroeconomic and Sectoral Statistics

The Meeting of Heads of National Statistical Offices of BRICS Countries is expected to be attended by representatives from Brazil, Russia, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, and UAE and with the objective to further strengthen cooperation in the areas of dissemination of statistics through BRICS JSP, innovation in statistical systems, and the exchange of knowledge and best practices.

Two half-day side events with participation from National Statistical Offices of BRICS Countries, policymakers, academia, think tanks, civil society organizations and technical experts, are also being organized alongside the BRICS Heads of National Statistical Offices (NSOs) Meeting on the following themes:

  • Unlocking the Potential of Administrative Data 03 August 2026)
  • Al Readiness in the Evolving Data Ecosystem 04 August 2026)

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Coal
Commercial Coal Mining: Fuelling India's Journey Towards Aatmanirbhar Bharat
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 2:33PM by PIB Delhi

Coal meets the larger part of India's energy requirement. It accounts for close to 55 per cent of the country's primary energy needs and fuels more than 70 per cent of the electricity generated. India holds the world's fifth largest coal resource, assessed at about 4,00,715 Million Tonnes (MT), and ranks as the second largest producer and consumer of coal. Around five lakh mine workers produce this coal across more than 350 mines.

Domestic coal production has crossed one billion tonnes for two consecutive years, at 1047.52 MT in FY 2024-25 and 1040.08 MT in FY 2025-26, compared with 609.18 MT in FY 2014-15. A substantial part of this growth has come from captive and commercial blocks, whose share of national production has risen from 10.9 per cent in FY 2021-22 to 20.2 per cent in FY 2025-26.

In 2014, the Supreme Court of India cancelled 204 of the 218 blocks allocated between 1993 and 2012, finding the process arbitrary for want of consistent and objective criteria, and made clear the need for a transparent, auction-based framework.

In response, the Coal Mines (Special Provisions) Act, 2015 placed re-allocation on a firm statutory footing, and the first auction tranche was launched in December 2014. Between 2015 and 2020, ten tranches of auction and nine of allotment restored 76 coal mines to productive use.

On 18 June 2020, under the vision of the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and the Aatmanirbhar Bharat mission, commercial coal mining was formally launched, permitting the sale of coal on a competitive basis and extending participation beyond the public sector. A successful bidder may now sell coal to any consumer in any sector at market-determined prices, with no captive-use restriction and no bar on how the coal is utilised.

The erstwhile fixed charge per tonne was replaced by a revenue-sharing model, under which the bidder quotes a percentage of revenue payable to the Government. That share is indexed to the National Coal Index, so that the nation's return moves with the real value of the coal. Eligibility norms were broadened considerably. Prior mining experience is no longer required, joint ventures and consortia may participate, and 100 per cent foreign direct investment is permitted through the automatic route.

Since June 2020, 141 coal mines have been auctioned commercially across 14 rounds, with a combined peak rated capacity of 366.35 MT per annum. The average revenue share discovered is 24.17 per cent, six times the 4 per cent floor. Of these, 123 have gone to private players, and 44 of the successful bidders were entities that had not mined coal before.

Captive and commercial blocks together produced about 210.46 MT in FY 2025-26, crossing the 200 million tonne mark for the first time. A decade earlier the figure stood at 28.83 MT, a compound annual growth of about 22 per cent over the period. Within this, commercial mines have contributed about 26.12 MT in FY 2025-26, with 23 mines operational (obtained Mine Opening Permission). At full production, the blocks auctioned so far are expected to yield annual revenue of about Rs. 47,000 crore, draw capital expenditure of about Rs. 48,756 crore, and generate employment of about 4,75,000.

Returns to the exchequer have grown on a similar scale. Revenue from premium generation has risen from Rs. 461 crore in FY 2014-15 to Rs. 5,553 crore in FY 2025-26, a compound annual growth of about 26 per cent, accruing to the exchequer and to the producing States.

The present focus is on ensuring that every auctioned mine is brought into production. Through sustained efforts for ease of doing business, the clearances required for blocks operationalization have been reduced and simplified, thereby scheduled operationalization timelines have been shortened, from 51 months to 40 for fully explored blocks and from 66 to 52 for partially explored ones (effective from the 15th round now under way).

Every commercial coal block since June 2020 has been awarded through open auction. These reforms rest on transparency, competition and a level playing field between public and private players, strengthening the country's energy security, supporting its power and steel industries, and carrying India further towards the goal of Aatmanirbhar Bharat.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Textiles
New Delhi to host “GI & Beyond 2.0 Summit” on 5 August
Summit to showcase India's GI-tagged Handloom and Handicraft Products
Digital Handloom Atlas and Diamond Jubilee Logo of HEPC among the key highlights
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 2:08PM by PIB Delhi

To promote India's rich Geographical Indication (GI) handloom and handicraft products and strengthen their position in domestic and international markets, the Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms), Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, in association with the Handloom Export Promotion Council (HEPC), will organise the GI & Beyond 2.0 Summit‟ on 5 August 2026 at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi.

The Summit will be inaugurated by Shri Pabitra Margherita, Minister of State for External Affairs & Textiles, Government of India, as the Chief Guest. Smt. Neelam Shami Rao, IAS, Secretary (Textiles), Government of India, will be the Guest of Honour in the gracious presence of Dr. M. Beena, IAS, Development Commissioner (Handlooms), Smt. Amrit Raj, Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) and Prof. (Dr.) Unnat P. Pandit, Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks (CGPDTM), RoC, GI & SICLDR.

The Summit aims to promote India's GI-tagged handloom and handicraft products and facilitate collaboration among stakeholders across the GI ecosystem. It will bring together overseas buyers from about 10 countries, exporters and multinational corporations (MNCs) from across India, registered proprietors of GI products, officials from Central and State Government Departments, and experts from leading textile brands, retail chains, e-commerce platforms, academia and industry.

A key feature of the Summit will be the display of more than 100 GI-registered handloom and handicraft products from across the country. The event will also feature thematic displays showcasing India's diverse weaving traditions and live demonstrations of handloom weaving and handicrafts.

During the inaugural session, GI Certificates will be presented to Registered Proprietors and new Authorised Users. The Summit will also witness the launch of the Digital Handloom Atlas – “One Platform. Endless Markets”, a comprehensive digital platform designed to showcase India's handloom products, including GI products, and connect artisans with global markets. The Diamond Jubilee Logo of the Handloom Export Promotion Council (HEPC) will also be unveiled on the occasion.

The programme will also include a special presentation by experts from IIT Madras on the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for strengthening the GI ecosystem. Technical sessions during the Summit will deliberate on GI Registration & Intellectual Property Rights, promotion of GI products in the domestic market, and strategies for leveraging GI handloom products in international markets.

The Summit will bring together a distinguished gathering of overseas buyers, exporters, leading textile and retail brands, multinational corporations (MNCs), e-commerce platforms, GI authorised users, policymakers, Government officials, industry experts, intellectual property professionals and academia, and is expected to serve as an important platform for collaboration among stakeholders.

item.content:encoded:
President's Secretariat
PRESIDENT OF INDIA FLAGS OFF THE PBG SOLDIERATHON
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 1:56PM by PIB Delhi

The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu virtually flagged off the PBG (President’s Bodyguards) Soldierathon from a ceremony held at the Forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhavan today (August 2, 2026) in the presence of General (Dr) VK Singh (Retd), Governor of Mizoram, who is the patron of the initiative. She also released the Special Postal Cover to commemorate the occasion. The venue of the race was Cariappa Parade Ground, Delhi Cantonment.

The Soldierathon serves as a unique platform to strengthen the bond between civilians and the Armed Forces, guided by the vision of 'Run for Soldiers, Run with Soldiers.' Centred on the theme 'Supporting Real Heroes – the Armed Forces of India,' the event pays tribute to the dedication, courage and sacrifice of our soldiers while encouraging citizens to express their solidarity with them through active participation.

The Soldierathon races are held in three categories - 3Km, 5Km, 10Km. Proceeds of Soldierathon are utilized to support the Paraplegic Rehabilitation Centre of Armed Forces, welfare of wards of battle casualties, etc. PBG Soldierathon intends to support the horses and troops of the PBG.

item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister's Office
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi launches ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan’
I urge every citizen, especially our youth, to join this movement: PM
Today, as the nation has set the goal of a Viksit Bharat, it is imperative that the country's youth remain physically and mentally fit, brimming with self-confidence, and permanently steer clear of destructive habits like drugs: PM
We must protect every youth from falling into the trap of addiction: PM
The support of society, the power of yoga and meditation, these give strength to our inner selves against addiction, and today we even have facilities like rehabilitation centers to quit addiction: PM
Even if a youth has mistakenly fallen into the trap of addiction, it absolutely does not mean that all doors are closed for them: PM
We must always remember, if a child in the house falls victim to addiction, do not hide it under the guise of social prestige; Seek help from whoever is needed; Try to free your child from addiction with medical help: PM
We should also create a culture of open communication with children in the family, so that you can hold their hand before they get caught in such a whirlpool: PM
I would also like to make an appeal to our professors at colleges and universities; alongside regular coursework, please discuss the perils of drug abuse with your students, spearhead a movement against addiction on your campuses; Your efforts can yield significant results: PM
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 1:48PM by PIB Delhi

Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today launched ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan’. Addressing a massive nationwide video conference, the Prime Minister formally greeted the diverse assembly including over one crore young citizens connected from more than 28,000 locations. Emphasizing the collective weight of the moment, he framed the gathering as a profound national commitment. "Today, all of us countrymen have united for a great and important resolution," remarked Shri Modi.

Highlighting the comprehensive nature of the initiative, the Prime Minister explained that the campaign transcends individual wellness, simultaneously serving the broader interests of families, society, and the entire nation. Outlining the core objective behind the 'Drug-Free Youth for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan', he stressed that achieving Viksit Bharat fundamentally requires a physically healthy, mentally robust, and highly confident younger generation completely free from self-destructive habits. ''Today, as the nation has set the goal of a Viksit Bharat,  it is imperative that the country's youth remain physically and mentally fit, brimming with self-confidence, and permanently steer clear of destructive habits like drugs," asserted Shri Modi.

Reflecting on the campaign's origins, the Prime Minister expressed deep satisfaction that the initiative initially launched as a pilot project from the sacred land of Kashi the previous year. Highlighting the unique blend of scientific clarity, spiritual energy, and profound cultural dedication driving the movement, he noted its massive expansion. "Supported by over 125 spiritual organizations and numerous NGOs under the Kashi Declaration, that welfare-driven idea has now successfully become a National project," observed Shri Modi.

Commending the millions of youth who took the anti-drug oath, the Prime Minister praised their solemn commitment to maintaining personal sobriety while actively disseminating the message of a drug-free life across their schools, colleges, and communities. Outlining the campaign's ambitious 100-week roadmap, he detailed how every upcoming Sunday will feature dedicated activities spanning art, culture, sports, and meditation to continually engage new participants. "The coming 100 Sundays will absolutely become 100 strong steps in the direction of a completely drug-free India," affirmed Shri Modi.

Addressing the vast online gathering of students, NSS members, and My Bharat volunteers, the Prime Minister expressed immense pride in the profound awareness, sensibility, and serious dedication demonstrated by the nation's youth. Positioning the younger demographic as India's 'Amrit generation', he reminded them that their energy, imagination, and talent are vital for guiding the nation toward its 2047 developmental goals. "For the ultimate future of the country and for your own lives, it is absolutely essential to keep yourselves free from addiction," asserted Shri Modi.

Contrasting the stellar achievements of today's youth in startups, artificial intelligence, sports, and space exploration with the devastating impacts of substance abuse, the Prime Minister delivered a stark warning about how addiction derails focus and destroys dreams. Illustrating the profound collateral damage inflicted upon families, from shattering parents' dreams to causing daily agony for elders, he emphasized the broader societal toll. "When this devastation happens in a family or society, the overall strength of the entire nation also fundamentally weakens," noted Shri Modi.

Warning the youth against the deceptive nature of narcotics, the Prime Minister stressed that the temporary high provided by drugs ultimately results in a permanent low for their careers and family lives. Drawing upon the profound wisdom of Indian culture and spiritual leaders, including specific teachings from the Sri Guru Granth Sahib, he highlighted the historical societal rejection of mind-altering substances. "We must absolutely not give any kind of social acceptance to intoxication under any circumstances," asserted Shri Modi.

Detailing the comprehensive support systems available for recovery, the Prime Minister highlighted the effectiveness of societal cooperation, yoga, meditation, and modern rehabilitation centers in overcoming addiction. Urging families to prioritize medical intervention over misguided concerns regarding social prestige, he advocated for a culture of open domestic communication to prevent vulnerable children from falling into the trap. "If a youth has mistakenly fallen into addiction, it absolutely does not mean that all their paths are permanently closed," affirmed Shri Modi.

Directing a specific appeal to academic professionals, the Prime Minister urged college and university professors to actively integrate discussions about the dangers of drugs into their regular curriculum and launch dedicated anti-intoxication movements on their campuses. Shifting focus to those recovering from addiction, he called for societal respect and second chances for these individuals, completely rejecting the stigma associated with their past. "The youth who come out fighting addiction are not weak; they are real warriors whose incredible courage is their true identity," remarked Shri Modi.

Concluding the address, the Prime Minister assured the youth that the government stands firmly alongside them in this crucial battle, citing unprecedented nationwide crackdowns, massive seizures worth thousands of crores, and soaring arrest rates targeting drug dealers and smugglers. Expressing unwavering faith in the younger generation's resilience, he predicted a highly successful outcome for the national initiative. "I am confident that our youth will protect their energy by staying free from addiction and will take the resolutions of Viksit Bharat forward," affirmed Shri Modi.

 

Speaking at the launch of 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan', a 100-week campaign against substance abuse. I urge every citizen, especially our youth, to join this movement. https://t.co/ucvrcAyK4C

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 2, 2026

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Textiles
‘Worlds Within Cloth: New Orders of Woven Making’ to Open at National Crafts Museum & Hastkala Academy
Exhibition open to visitors from 6 to 19 August
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 1:45PM by PIB Delhi

The Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms), Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, will inaugurate the exhibition Worlds Within Cloth: New Orders of Woven Making on 5 August 2026 at Virasat Hall, National Crafts Museum & Hastkala Academy, New Delhi. The exhibition will remain open to the public from 06 to 19 August 2026 between 11:00 AM and 6:00 PM as part of the celebrations leading upto the 12th National Handloom Day on 7th of August. Members of the public are invited to experience this unique presentation of contemporary textile practices and their evolving relationship with India's living handloom traditions.

The inaugural ceremony will be graced by Smt. Neelam Shami Rao, Secretary, Ministry of Textiles, as the Chief Guest, in the gracious presence of Dr. M. Beena, Development Commissioner (Handlooms), Smt. Amrit Raj, Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) and Padma Bhushan Shri Rajeev Sethi.

The exhibition, curated by Sreyansi Singh, will bring together contemporary textile artists, designers and craft collectives whose practices expand the understanding of handlooms beyond their material form. Through research-driven works, artist–artisan collaborations and immersive installations, the exhibition will examine the social, historical and cultural contexts of textile-making while foregrounding experimentation, interdisciplinary approaches and new modes of engagement with craft traditions.

Featuring works by Aadyam Handwoven, Abraham & Thakore, Astha Butail, Boito, Chanakya School, Coonoor & Co., Jagrity Phukan, Jayeeta Chatterjee, Kardo, Morii, Neeraj Patel, Porgai Artisans Association, Shradha Kochhar, Shrujan, Studio Medium, Ujjal Dey and 23 N 69 E, the exhibition highlights diverse contemporary practices that engage with India's handloom heritage through innovation, collaboration and critical inquiry. Several participating artists are supported by leading galleries and cultural institutions, reflecting the growing dialogue between contemporary art and craft.

The exhibition seeks to foster greater appreciation of contemporary textile practice by presenting cloth as a medium of knowledge, cultural memory and creative expression. By bringing together artists, designers, artisans and craft collectives, it encourages meaningful dialogue on the evolving role of textiles in addressing questions of identity, sustainability, community and material culture. This exhibition will be a celebration of the dynamic intersections of traditional craftsmanship and contemporary artistic practice.

***

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
NBA releases Rs 8.22 crore to rice research institutions and rice-growing States
One of the largest single benefit-sharing disbursements for rice, realized from an international seed company that used Indian rice varieties to develop and commercialize hybrids
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 1:41PM by PIB Delhi

The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) has released Rs 8.22 crore to three research institutions and 33 State Biodiversity Boards and Union Territory Biodiversity Councils, marking one of the largest single access and benefit-sharing (ABS) disbursements for rice.

The amount was received from M/s Pioneer Overseas Corporation, an international seed company, for using Indian rice (Oryza sativa) varieties to develop and commercialize hybrids. The disbursement reflects India's commitment to ensuring fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from the utilization of the country's biological resources.

Of the total amount, Rs 2.47 crore has been released to research institutions that conserved and shared the rice varieties with the company. ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Hyderabad, has received the largest share of Rs 2.43 crore, while Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Uttarakhand, has received Rs 3.26 lakh for the specific rice variety it contributed.

An amount of Rs 5.75 crore has been released to 33 State Biodiversity Boards and Union Territory Biodiversity Councils based on the rice-growing area of each State and Union Territory, as listed in the Unified Portal for Agricultural Statistics of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. Uttar Pradesh has received the highest share of over Rs 73 lakh. States and Union Territories with smaller rice-growing areas, such as Sikkim and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, have also received proportionate allocations.

The top 10 State-wise allocations are as follows:

The research institutions will utilise the funds to strengthen germplasm conservation, maintain seed collections, and support research and training. The State Biodiversity Boards and Union Territory Biodiversity Councils will use their allocations for approved conservation activities, including protection of native crop diversity, ecosystem restoration, documentation of traditional knowledge, and support for local farmers and knowledge holders.

The NBA has so far received about Rs 83 crore in ABS payments from the agriculture and seed sector alone. Across all sectors, its total ABS disbursements have crossed Rs 162 crore.

By ensuring that benefits arising from the commercial use of India's biological resources are shared fairly with research institutions and States, the initiative contributes to Target 13 of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, which calls for fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from the utilization of genetic resources, including associated traditional knowledge. It also contributes to the Sustainable Development Goals, particularly SDG 2 (Zero Hunger), SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production), SDG 15 (Life on Land), and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals).

About the National Biodiversity Authority

The National Biodiversity Authority is a statutory body established under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. It regulates access to India's biological resources and associated traditional knowledge and implements the Nagoya Protocol's principle of fair and equitable benefit-sharing.

item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister's Office
Text of PM’s speech at the launch of ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan’ via VC
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 1:25PM by PIB Delhi

नमस्‍कार!

आज हम सभी देशवासी एक महान और महत्वपूर्ण संकल्प के लिए एकजुट हुए हैं। इस संकल्प को लेकर, इसक कार्यक्रम से जुड़े सभी पूज्य संतजन, अलग-अलग राज्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रहे सभी राज्यपाल, सभी मुख्यमंत्री, अन्‍य सभी जनप्रतिनिधिगण, 28 हजार से अधिक स्थानों से जुड़े एक करोड़ से युवा साथी, मैं आज इस शुभ घड़ी पर, शुभ संकल्प के लिए करोड़ों-करोड़ों नौजवानों का विशेष रूप से अभिनंदन करता हूं। आज हम सभी जिस अभियान के साक्षी बन रहे हैं, वह अभियान व्यक्ति के लिए हैं, परिवार के लिए हैं, समाज के लिए भी है और सबसे बड़ी बात है, यह राष्‍ट्र के लिए है। 

साथियों, 

विकसित भारत संकल्प अभियान के लिए ‘नशा मुक्त युवा’ इस मूवमेंट का नाम ही इसके संकल्प को स्पष्ट करता है, क्योंकि आज जब देश ने विकसित भारत का लक्ष्य तय किया है, तो इसके लिए आवश्यक है, देश का युवा तन से स्वस्थ हो, मन से स्वस्थ हो, आत्‍मविश्‍वास से भरपूर हो और ड्रग्स जैसी घातक आदत से हमेशा-हमेशा दूर ही रहे, दूर हो। यही इस अभियान का उद्देश्य है। इसलिए हम सबको यह संकल्प लेना है, हमारे युवा नशे और ड्रग्स के खतरों को समझे, हर तरह से जागरूक रहे और उससे दूर रहें और इस संकल्प में अब ‘राष्‍ट्रीय नशा मुक्त युवा’ अभियान की बड़ी भूमिका है।

साथियों,

काशी का सांसद होने के नाते मुझे खुशी है कि यह अभियान का पायलट प्रोजेक्ट के तौर पर पिछले साल काशी की पवित्र धरती से शुरू हुआ था। इसलिए वैज्ञानिक स्‍पष्‍टता के साथ-साथ इसमें आध्यात्मिक ऊर्जा भी है, संतों के आशीर्वाद भी हैं और महान सांस्कृतिक विरासत भी हैं। इसमें वह सांस्कृतिक समर्पण भी है, जिसने सदियों से नशे को खारिज किया है। यही वजह है, देश के 125 से अधिक आध्यात्मिक संगठन करोड़ों-करोड़ों देशवासियों के हित के लिए आज हमारे साथ जुड़ चुके हैं। सामाजिक संगठनों ने, NGOs ने इस दिशा में संकल्प लिया है। सबने मिलकर ‘काशी डिक्लेरेशन’ के जरिए रोडमैप तैयार किया है और आज हम देख रहे हैं, काशी से उठा वो कल्याणकारी विचार अब यह एक नेशनल प्रोजेक्ट्स बन गया है। आज से देशभर में ‘नशा मुक्त युवा’ अभियान आरंभ हो रहा है। 

साथियों, 

कुछ काम ऐसे होते हैं, जो व्यक्तिगत रूप से कोई प्रयास करे, तो कभी-कभी निराश हो जाता है, थकान महसूस करता है, लंबी दूरी चलने में मन तैयार नहीं होता है, लेकिन जब सामूहिक अभियान बन जाता है, कंधे से कंधा मिलाकर करोड़ों लोग चल पड़ते हैं, तो ऐसे सभी जो व्यक्तिगत रूप से अपने आप कुछ नहीं कर पाते हैं, उनको भी एक नई ऊर्जा मिल जाती है। सामूहिकता की एक ताकत होती है और आज उस ताकत को लेकर के यह अभियान हर युवा मन को छूने वाला है। थोड़ी देर पहले देश के लाखों युवाओं ने नशा मुक्ति की शपथ ली है। आपने अपने जीवन को नशे से दूर रखने का संकल्प लिया है। आपने अपने स्कूल, अपने कॉलेज और अपने समाज में नशा मुक्ति का संदेश पहुंचाने का संकल्प लिया है। 

साथियों, 

आज लिया गया यह संकल्प आने वाले 100 सप्ताह तक लगातार ऐसे ही आगे बढ़ेगा। हर रविवार, कला, संस्‍कृति, स्पोर्ट्स, मेडिटेशन, आध्यात्म और सेवा से जुड़ी गतिविधियां होंगी। नशा मुक्ति का संदेश नए लोगों तक पहुंचेगा। आने वाले 100 रविवार नशा मुक्त भारत की दिशा में 100 मजबूत कदम होंगे, हंड्रेड मजबूत स्‍टेप्‍स। 

साथियों, 

आज हजारों स्कूलों, कॉलेजों और यूनिवर्सिटीज़ के लाखों विद्यार्थी इस कार्यक्रम से ऑनलाइन जुड़े हैं। माई भारत के वॉलंटियर्स भी लाखों की तादाद में आज इससे जुड़े हैं। मेरे एनएसएस के नौजवान भी आज हमारे साथ शामिल हैं। देश के अलग-अलग क्षेत्रों से, अलग-अलग संस्‍थानों से, अलग-अलग बैकग्राउंड के एक करोड़ से अधिक युवा आज एक साथ हैं। मेरा आप सभी से आग्रह है, आप सब इस बड़े मोवमेंट के लीडर हैं। आपने मेरे इस विश्वास को और मजबूत किया है कि भारत का युवा कितना जागरूक है, कितना समझदार है और अपने कर्तव्यों के प्रति कितना गंभीर है। मैं आप सभी को इस अभियान के लिए अनेक-अनेक शुभकामनाएं देता हूं। 

मेरे युवा साथियों,

आप भारत की अमृत पीढ़ी हैं। आप अगले 20-25 वर्षों में अपने जीवन को भी दिशा देंगे और आप ही 2047 में देश को विकसित भारत की मंजिल तक लेकर जाएंगे और उसको शिखर पर आप ही बैठे होंगे, उसका सारा रसपान करने का अवसर आप ही को मिलने वाला है। देश को आपकी ऊर्जा, आपकी कल्पनाशक्ति और आपके टैलेंट की जरूरत है। इसलिए, देश के लिए और अपने जीवन के लिए, खुद को नशा मुक्त रखना बहुत जरूरी है। नशा फोकस को भटकाता है, और धीरे-धीरे युवा को उसके अपने सपनों से दूर ले जाता है। अभी जिन नौजवानों ने नाट्य मंचन किया, बहुत कम समय में, बहुत अच्छे तरीके से नाट्य मंचन में उन्होंने समस्या भी बताई, समस्या के कारण पैदा हुए संकट भी बताए और बाहर निकलने के सामूहिक प्रयत्न का रास्ता भी दिखाया। नाट्य मंचन छोटा था, लेकिन जैसा उन्होंने कहा, आओ हम नाटक देखें! यह नाटक नहीं था, यह हम लोगों के लिए एक बहुत बड़ा संदेश था। हमें जगा रहा था, हमें जूझने के लिए प्रेरित कर रहा था। 

साथियों,

आजकल हम देखते हैं, आज के युवा स्‍टार्टअप्‍स की दुनिया में छाए हैं, AI को लीड कर रहे हैं, Sports में तिरंगा लहरा रहे हैं, स्‍पेस से लेकर Science तक नए कीर्तिमान बना रहे हैं। लेकिन साथियों, जब कोई युवा, अगर ड्रग्स के एडिक्‍शन में फंस जाए, तो केवल एक युवा नहीं हारता, एक सपना हार जाता है, एक सपने की बाल मृत्यु हो जाती है, एक परिवार हार जाता है, पूरा का पूरा परिवार टूट जाता है, समाज से भी नफरत का शिकार बन जाता है। नशा केवल शरीर को नुकसान नहीं पहुंचाता, नशा एक माँ की मुस्कान छीन लेता है। नशा एक पिता के सपनों को चूर-चूर कर देता है। एक बहन की राखी की उम्मीद को कमजोर कर देता है। एक छोटे भाई का आदर्श छीन लेता है। घर के बुजुर्ग हर दिन इस दर्द को जीते हैं कि उनका अपना बच्चा धीरे-धीरे खुद को खो रहा है, खुद को गला रहा है, तिल-तिल गल रहा है, आंखों के सामने उसे बर्बाद होते देख रहे हैं और जब परिवार में, समाज में ऐसा होता है और कहीं न कहीं, राष्ट्र की शक्ति भी कमजोर पड़ जाती है और इसलिए दुश्मन देश भी षड्यंत्र करके हमारे देश के युवाओं को इस नशे की लत में खींचने के लिए कोई कोशिश बाकी नहीं रखते हैं। ड्रग्स सप्लाई कर-करके कमाई करना और हमारे जैसे देश को तबाह करना, यह भी उनकी आतंकी साजिश का हिस्सा होता है और इसलिए हमें हर एक युवा को नशे के चंगुल में फंसने से बचाना है।

साथियों,

नशा मुक्त रहकर आपको अपने पोटेंशियल को प्रोटेक्ट करना है! आपको ध्यान रखना है, ड्रग्स कुछ समय के लिए 'High' देता है। लेकिन आपके करियर और फैमिली लाइफ को 'Low' कर देता है। हमें नशे को किसी भी तरह की स्वीकार्यता नहीं देनी है।

साथियों,

हमारे समाज में भी हमेशा नशे को एक बुराई के रूप में देखा है। हमारे संतों ने, गुरुओं ने हमें इससे बचने के लिए चेताया। श्री गुरु ग्रंथ साहिब में भी कहा गया है- "जितु पीतै मति दूरि होइ बरलु पवै विचि आइ। आपणा पराइआ न पछाणई खसमहु धके खाइ॥'' अर्थात, जिस पदार्थ के सेवन से बुद्धि और विवेक साथ छोड़ दें, इंसान अपने और पराए की पहचान भूल जाए, ऐसा नशा उसे पतन की ओर ले जाता है। 

साथियों,

हमारी संस्कृति में बचाव के लिए चेतावनी भी दी गईं है और नशे की आदत लगने पर उससे निकलने के रास्ते भी बताए गए हैं। समाज का सहयोग, योग और ध्यान की ताकत, यह नशे के खिलाफ हमारे अंतर्मन को ताकत देते हैं। और आज तो हमारे पास नशा छोड़ने के लिए rehabilitation center जैसी सुविधाएं भी हैं। इसलिए, अगर कोई युवा गलती से नशे में फंस भी गया है, तो इसका ये मतलब बिल्कुल नहीं है कि उसके सारे रास्ते बंद हो गए हैं। हमें हमेशा इस बात का ध्यान रखना है, घर का कोई बच्चा अगर नशे का शिकार बन गया है, तो इसे सामाजिक प्रतिष्ठा की आड़ में छिपाएं नहीं। जिसकी जरूरत हो, उसका सहयोग मांगे, मन खोलकर के उससे बात करें, जो एक्सपर्ट्स हैं, उनका सहयोग लें। मेडिकल हेल्प से अपने बच्चे को नशे से मुक्त कराने का प्रयास करें। हमें परिवार में बच्चों से खुलकर संवाद की संस्कृति भी बनानी चाहिए, ताकि ऐसे भंवर में फंसने से पहले ही आप उसका हाथ थाम सके। आपको भनक आ जाएगी, थोड़ा ध्यान रखिए पता चलेगा, उसमें बदलाव आ रहा है, वो खोया-खोया लग रहा है, वो मुँह छुपा रहा है, कमरे में बंद हो जा रहा है, देर रात आ रहा है, पैसे अनाब-शनाब मांग रहा है, यह सारी चीजों से पता चल जाता है, भनक आ जाती है, कुछ मामला गड़बड़ है। 

साथियों,

एक आवाहन मैं कॉलेज और यूनिवर्सिटीज़ के हमारे प्रोफेसर्स साथियों से भी करना चाहता हूँ, आप भी कोर्स की पढ़ाई के साथ-साथ स्टूडेंट्स के साथ ड्रग्स के खतरों पर बात करें। नशे के खिलाफ अपने कैम्पस में एक मूवमेंट चलाएं। आपके प्रयास बड़े-बड़े परिणाम ला सकते हैं। और साथियों, हमें एक और बात ध्यान रखनी है, जो युवा नशे से लड़कर बाहर निकलते हैं, वह कमजोर नहीं होते, जो नशे को परास्‍त करके निकला है न, वह असली योद्धा होता है, समाज को उनका सम्मान करना चाहिए, अपनापन देना चाहिए, उसे दूसरा अवसर देना चाहिए क्योंकि ड्रग्स से जुड़ा किसी का अतीत उसकी पहचान नहीं हो सकता, उसका साहस उसकी पहचान होता है। 

साथियों,

ड्रग्स के खिलाफ अभियान में आज सरकार भी मजबूती से युवाओं के साथ खड़ी है। देश में नशे के कारोबारियों और तस्करों पर सख्ती के साथ कार्रवाई हो रही है। पहले की तुलना में कई गुना ज्यादा गिरफ्तारियां हुई हैं। हजारों करोड़ रुपए की ड्रग्स भी जब्त की गई है। यह दिखाता है कि, ड्रग्स के खिलाफ हमारी सरकार कितनी सख्त है। मुझे विश्वास है, केन्‍द्र सरकार, राज्य सरकार, हर कोई इसे मिशन मोड में करेंगे। मुझे विश्वास है, हमारे देश का युवा नशे से मुक्त रहकर अपनी युवा ऊर्जा को न केवल संरक्षित करेगा, बल्कि विकसित भारत के संकल्पों को भी आगे बढ़ाएगा। और जब मैं आज अनेक महान संतों को मेरे सामने देख रहा हूं, दूर से मैं मन से उनको प्रणाम करता हूं। मैं इन सभी सामाजिक संस्‍थाएं, आध्यात्मिक संस्‍थाएं, आध्यात्मिक गुरुजन, आपका देश के कोने-कोने में संगठन है, आपके युवा साथी डिवोटीज हैं। आने वाले 100 दिन में हर एक संगठन, एक सप्ताह अपने जिम्मे ले सकता है, पूरा सप्ताह पूरे देश में वह संगठन नेतृत्व करे, बाकी सब शक्तियां उसके साथ जुड़े और रविवार को बहुत बड़ा कार्यक्रम करें। दूसरे सप्ताह, दूसरा संगठन, दूसरी शक्ति, सप्ताह भर प्रयोग करें, कार्यक्रम करे और रविवार को बड़ा कार्यक्रम करे। अगर 100 सप्ताह हमारे देश के ऐसे आध्यात्मिक, सामाजिक संगठन, युवा संगठन एक-एक सप्ताह अपने जिम्मे ले लें और बाकी सारी शक्तियां वह जुड़े और रविवार सब मिलकर के करें, आप कल्पना कर सकते हैं, देश में कितना बड़ा आंदोलन खड़ा हो जाएगा। मैं एक बार फिर आप सबने समय निकाला, इस पवित्र कार्य में हम सबको आशीर्वाद दिए, इसके लिए संतों का, आचार्यो का, संगठन के महारथियों का हृदय से आभार व्यक्त करता हूं। मैं इन एक करोड़ से ज्यादा जुटे नौजवानों का विशेष रूप से अभिनंदन करता हूं, आपने यह बहुत बड़ा काम किया है। मैं माई भारत के वॉलंटियर्स की बधाई करता हूं, वो जो भी ठान लेते हैं, आजकल करके दिखाते हैं। अभी पिछले दिनों मुझे माई भारत के वॉलंटियर्स को मिलने का मौका मिला, वह हिन्‍दुस्‍तान के सीमावर्ती गांवों में जाकर के एक-एक सप्ताह रूक करके आए हैं। जिसे कभी देश का आखिरी गांव कहा जाता है, जाता था जिसको आज हम देश का पहला गांव कहते हैं, वहां जाकर के आए। उनके अनुभव बड़े प्रेरक थे और आज इतना बड़ा कार्यक्रम माई भारत के वॉलंटियर्स कर पाते हैं, यह अपने आप में उनकी राष्‍ट्र के प्रति जागरूक समर्पित भावना का प्रतीक है, मैं उनकी बधाई देता हूं, उनका भी अभिनंदन करता हूं। और मुझे पूरा विश्वास है कि आप सबके सामूहिक प्रयत्नों से यह हमारी मोवमेंट घर-घर पहुंचेगी, हर युवा के दिन में पहुंचेगी और यह ड्रग्स के कारोबारियों के लिए बहुत बड़ा खौफ भी बन जाएगी। आइए, हम सब मिलकर के आगे चलें, मेरी आप सबको बहुत-बहुत शुभकामनाएं! 

बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद!

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Defence
NCC ORGANISES CYCLOTHON 2026 TO COMMEMORATE 79 YEARS OF INDIA'S INDEPENDENCE
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 12:54PM by PIB Delhi

The National Cadet Corps (NCC) organised Cyclothon 2026 on August 02, 2026 in New Delhi to commemorate 79 years of India's Independence. The initiative aimed to inspire the youth to embrace fitness, environmental responsibility, and sustainable living while reinforcing the core values of patriotism, discipline, unity, and national service that form the foundation of the National Cadet Corps.

The Cyclothon was flagged off by the Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports, Shri Mansukh Mandaviya, in the presence of the Minister of State for Defence, Shri Sanjay Seth, Defence Secretary Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh, renowned boxer M C Mary Kom and renowned tennis player Leander Paes. Director General, NCC, Lieutenant General Virendra Vats led the group of 79 NCC cadets in a symbolic 79 kilometre ride to mark 79 years of India's Independence. The event commenced from Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium and concluded at the same venue after successfully covering the designated route through prominent landmarks of the National Capital.

Organised under the theme "Clean India, Green India, Fit India," the Cyclothon reaffirmed NCC's commitment to national missions such as TB Mukt Bharat, Swachh Bharat, Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam, and Har Ghar Tiranga. The event encouraged participants and the public to adopt cycling as an eco-friendly and sustainable mode of transport while promoting environmental conservation, reducing carbon emissions, and embracing healthy lifestyles.

Beyond being a sporting event, NCC Cyclothon 2026 served as a platform to create awareness about physical fitness, environmental stewardship, road safety, and responsible citizenship. The initiative inspired the youth to become ambassadors of positive social change by embracing discipline, teamwork, resilience, and community service, thereby contributing to the vision of a stronger, healthier, and greener India.

Prime Minister's Office
Prime Minister congratulates Gulveer Singh on winning Bronze in Men’s 5000m
Posted On: 02 AUG 2026 12:03PM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated Gulveer Singh on winning the Bronze medal in the Men’s 5000m event at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow.

The Prime Minister said that with this remarkable performance, Gulveer Singh became the first Indian athlete to win two athletics medals at a single Commonwealth Games. He also noted that Gulveer Singh is the first Indian to win a Commonwealth Games medal in the Men’s 5000m event.

Shri Modi described the achievement as a landmark moment for Indian athletics and extended his best wishes to Gulveer Singh.

In a post on X, Shri Modi said;

“History made by Gulveer Singh! He wins the Bronze Medal in the Men's 5000 m event at the Commonwealth Games 2026. Congratulations to him. With this remarkable performance, he became the first Indian athlete to win two athletics medals at a single Commonwealth Games. He is also the first-ever Indian to win a Commonwealth Games medal in the Men's 5000 m event. This is indeed a landmark achievement for Indian athletics. My best wishes to him.

#CWG2026”

With this remarkable performance, he became the first Indian athlete to win two athletics medals at a single Commonwealth Games. He is also… pic.twitter.com/nFC2oCvP7F
